verdict.line: You lose if you let Malphite farm free Q pokes to level 6 and then eat his all-in; you win by abusing his long cooldowns before then.

brief.thesis: Malphite's entire kit runs on short cooldowns that recharge fast, but none of them hit you more than once per engage, while Kled's W (Violent Tendencies) and E (Jousting) let him win extended trades if he commits every cooldown at once. The 56% win rate over 109 games reflects that Kled can out-trade Malphite before level 6 and again whenever Unstoppable Force is down, since Malphite has no answer to sustained melee pressure outside his ultimate.

tell.watch: Malphite's R cooldown and Granite Shield recharge

theirWindow.what: Malphite will look for a knock-up all-in near the tower or for a roam window. Hold Skaarl's courage bar high and keep E (Jousting) off cooldown so you can dash away or re-engage the instant he lands it.

yourWindow.when: his E (Ground Slam) or R just used
yourWindow.what: Ground Slam has only a 7s cooldown so track it closely, but when both it and R are down, Malphite has no attack-speed shred or displacement left. Dive with W (Violent Tendencies) active and double E (Jousting) through him.

runes.keystoneWhy: run at 52.6% pick rate and 28.8% win share; stacks through extended W (Violent Tendencies) trades and rewards you for staying in melee range

summoners.why: highest win rate pairing at 60.2% with 78.6% pick rate; Ignite punishes his Granite Shield recharge window and seals early all-ins before he hits 6

playing.title: Trade before level 6
playing.detail: Malphite has no displacement until R, so use W (Violent Tendencies) for the attack speed burst and follow with E (Jousting) to dash in and out. His Granite Shield punishes the first hit, so bait it with a minion or your Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) throw first.

playing.title: Track Granite Shield recharge
playing.detail: The shield only refills if he hasn't been hit recently. Keep landing autos or Q hooks every few seconds so the shield never comes back online during your trade.

playing.title: Respect R at level 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force has an 1000 range and knocks you airborne. Don't overextend past minion waves once he hits 6, since it's a long-range engage tool, not just a teamfight ultimate.

playing.title: Use double E through him
playing.detail: Jousting can be recast to dash back through your initial target for a second hit of damage. Walk him away from a point you can dash back through, like a wave or ward, to maximize uptime.

playing.title: Save Q for punishing cooldowns
playing.detail: Bear Trap on a Rope yanks him toward you on a 11-7s cooldown depending on rank. Throw it right after he uses Ground Slam or Seismic Shard so he can't escape the follow-up.

playing.title: Dismount changes your kit
playing.detail: If Skaarl's health depletes, your Q becomes Pocket Pistol, a knockback that restores courage. Use it to peel off Malphite mid-fight when dismounted rather than trying to trade in close range.

playing.title: Itemize armor shred over raw AD
playing.detail: Black Cleaver's shred counters his Brutal Strikes armor buff directly, which matters more than bonus damage since his passive shield already blunts burst.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above come from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Malphite’s ultimate as he will try to get a kill then. If Malphite’s Ground Slam (E) is on cooldown, use Jousting [E] and Violent Tendencies [W] to deal damage.
